purpose: ADR-096 qualification gate item 3: three fresh whole-factory runs on ONE immutable build with DIFFERENT deterministic perturbation seeds. This table maps seed -> one named tape. A tape is pure SELECTION of an already-declared deterministic scenario variant (run-manifest.ts); no new fault logic lives here and NO random fault injection exists anywhere in the contract (the W9 harness forbids it).
selectionRule: seed n -> tapes[n mod tapes.length]; absent or unparseable seed -> the default tape (index 0). A seed whose tape belongs to another lane leaves the entrypoint on its current behavior; the resolved tape name is ALWAYS recorded in the drive evidence and validated against run-manifest tapeName.

tapes.name: golden-full-lifecycle
tapes.varies: Golden path — scripted happy handlers on every cell, zero crash points. This is the unseeded default drive (current behavior).

tapes.name: cross-execution-durability
tapes.varies: Named crash point 'author-lost-after-first-contribution' (invocation 1, exit-without-done): the first author execution is lost mid-production; crash repair reassigns the SAME workplace and both contributions must land in one accepted revision.

tapes.name: reviewer-reject-repair
tapes.varies: The final gate returns repair_required on the first reviewer assessment; a second immutable author CandidateSet plus a second assessment is accepted — exact subject_candidate_set_ref authority across the repair cycle.

tapes.name: carry-forward-authority
tapes.varies: The multi-task recency trap: the integration task is selected from the accepted-authority head (readAuthorTaskId), never from submission.task_id or ORDER BY id DESC.

tapes.name: frm-inconsistent
tapes.varies: The product-contract author traces the PRD to a non-brief root; settlement's canonical traceability check terminates Formalization inconsistent.

tapes.name: dev-blocked
tapes.varies: An out-of-band change lands on the integration branch after candidate freeze; settlement observes the drifted head and terminates Development blocked (candidate-drifted-after-freeze).

tapes.name: disc-deleted-word
tapes.varies: A discovery proposal recommends the DELETED outcome word 'defer'; the closed proposal enum rejects the submission as invalid input — the factory never rewrites a deleted word.

tapes.name: disc-clarify
tapes.varies: Discovery settles 'clarify'; the certificate records the code; the permissive gate still forwards to Formalization and the lifecycle completes.

tapes.name: disc-reject
tapes.varies: Discovery settles 'reject' with coherent readiness-advisor agreement; the certificate records the code; routing forwards to Formalization and the lifecycle completes.

tapes.name: silent-worker
tapes.varies: A worker goes silent (expired lease, stale heartbeat, no liveness, no completion receipt); the production reaper must classify it lost, release the card and leave accepted-authority heads untouched.

tapes.name: exit-without-done
tapes.varies: Named crash point 'author-exits-after-work-without-done' (invocation 1): real durable work, prints a summary, exits 0 without worker_done — the finalizer classifies it lost and crash repair converges.

tapes.name: fake-done-file
tapes.varies: Named crash point 'author-fakes-worker-done-file' (invocation 1): worker-done-call.json is forged on disk with a plausible payload and no MCP tool call; the file must be ignored exactly as prompt rule 6a states.

tapes.name: scope-widening-grant
tapes.varies: The first implementation card honestly requires atlas/registry-map.json outside its frozen changeScopes; two path-outside-authority rejections route to a scope-widening request; the carve authority grants it and the SAME workplace completes on the re-frozen wider scope.

tapes.name: scope-declared
tapes.varies: The same honest work via the typed conclusion: after the first scope rejection the worker ends its attempt with outcome 'scope-insufficient' naming atlas/; the same grant path serves it and the lifecycle completes runnable-local.
